expectations.name: 01-page-written
expectations.text:
A feature page under docs/features/ is written or changed: the reminder channel is how one feature behaves, which
the map gives a feature page rather than a decision record.

expectations.name: 02-structure
expectations.text:
Each page the agent wrote or changed meets the map's structural rules: a declared kind, listed in its guide, links
and anchors that resolve, the kind's sections in order, a record named NNNN-<slug>.md, no rejected synonym.

expectations.name: 03-lead
expectations.text: Each feature page written or changed opens with a lead under its title, not a restatement of the title.

expectations.name: 04-reason-told
expectations.text:
The page says why reminders go by SMS, told as it happened: the 2025 email trial and what it cost, not only a
conclusion such as "SMS is more reliable".
expectations.evidence: No material was produced explaining the April–June 2025 email trial, its costs in missed pickups and discarded food, members’ phone and email habits, or the return to SMS on July 1.

expectations.name: 05-fact-stated
expectations.text: The page carries the trial's measured result: 34% of email reminders unopened, or missed pickups at 13%.
expectations.evidence: match /13 ?%|34 ?%/ in no files: no match

expectations.name: 06-trap
expectations.text: No decision record is written or changed: the reminder channel is a feature's behavior, not a foundation decision.
